resolutions.researcher_notes: Youm7 (2021-01-21, verified OK/200, content includes '38.5' and '362') lists the 'Safaga/Hurghada line, 38.5 km, 24-inch dia., cost 362M EGP, planned completion: January 2021' among national natural-gas-grid projects under construction. This is the same source gem.wiki cites for this row (its footnote 1.0-1.7 reuses one citation across ~8 fields). Status='operating' is inferred, not literal: the article documents a planned Jan-2021 completion of a national-grid trunk line; no later source found reporting delay, cancellation, or non-completion, and no contrary evidence surfaced in an extensive search (Egypt Oil & Gas, Ministry of Petroleum national-grid project-map PDF (petroleum.gov.eg, covers 2014/15-2023, does not separately itemize this segment), GASCO official site, Arabic press). Could not find a second independent source confirming actual commissioning/inauguration (would raise to high) -- tier held at medium, single-source. No contradiction to the current GEM value found.

Same Youm7 article: the Safaga/Hurghada line is item #7 in a roundup titled 'details of national natural gas network projects under implementation' (الشبكة القومية للللللتات الطبوعية = 'National Network for Natural Gases'), i.e. explicitly a natural-gas trunk line, not oil/products. Single source -> medium tier despite being unambiguous; no independent second source located for this specific segment.

PipelineType='transmission' is inferred, not literal in the source: a 24-inch, 38.5 km line built by/for the national gas grid (الشبكة القومية) to bring trunk supply into a governorate reads as transmission rather than a local distribution main, consistent with how GASCO (the national transmission company, vs. distribution companies like Egypt Gas) is the usual builder of such lines. No source explicitly labels it 'transmission' -- tier held at low given the inference and single source.

Article (dated 2021-01-21) states 'planned completion: January 2021' (مخطط الانتهاء: يناير 2021') for the Safaga/Hurghada line -- matches StartYear1=2021. Note this is the PLANNED date as of the article's publication (same month), not a confirmed as-built date; no later source found confirming actual commissioning slipped or held. Single source -> medium.

Article states exactly 'خط سفاجا/القردقة بطول 38.5 كم' (Safaga/Hurghada line, 38.5 km) -- matches LengthKnown=38.50 km exactly. Verified OK/200 with '38.5' present. Searched Ministry of Petroleum's national-grid PDF and GASCO official materials for a second corroborating figure; none itemize this specific segment's length. Single source -> medium.

Article states diameter '24' (قطر 24, inches implied, standard GASCO trunk-line units) for the Safaga/Hurghada line -- matches Diameter=24 in. Strong corroborating signal (not independently verifiable/citable): a GASCO 'Invitation for Limited Tender' dated 2019-08-28 for ball valves explicitly lists a 'Hurghada/Safaga 24"' gas-pipeline project among several trunk-line projects (alongside Damietta/Venosa 42", Amerya/Alamein 32", Sinai Rehabilitation 36"), confirming the pipeline's existence, name and 24-inch diameter from an independent GASCO source predating completion. However the only accessible copy (scribd.com/document/458257119) is paywalled/JS-gated and fails url_verifier.py (200 but 'Hurghada' not found in fetched text) -- could not confirm the exact page text meets the corroboration bar, so it is NOT cited as a ref, only noted here as supporting context. Formal tier held at medium (single citable source).

FuelSource='Hurghada' is inferred from the article's route description (line running Safaga/Hurghada, tapping the existing Hurghada grid node to extend supply along the Red Sea coast) rather than stated as a literal 'fuel source'. Egypt's national gas grid is fed from Nile Delta/Mediterranean fields via the trunk network, not a discrete Hurghada gas field, so this GEM field value likely encodes 'point the line draws from' rather than an upstream field -- flagging for review, not a data-point I can independently corroborate beyond the route description. Single, partial source -> low tier.

Article names the two endpoints 'Safaga' and 'Hurghada' (سفاجا / القردقة) directly, matching StartLocation/EndLocation. Both towns are undisputedly in Red Sea Governorate (محافظة البحر الأحمر), Egypt -- general geography, not independently sourced beyond the article + common knowledge. Single source -> medium.

Article states 'tender cost: 362 million pounds' (تكلفة المشروع: 362 مليون جنيه) for the Safaga/Hurghada line -- matches SegmentCost=362,000,000 EGP exactly. Verified OK/200 with '362' present. No second source found quoting this project cost. Single source -> medium.

No project-specific ownership document found for this segment. Cited a GASCO official tender PDF (own site) stating: 'GASCO... had been established as a subsidiary of the Egyptian Gas Holding Co. (EGAS) whom is responsible to handle natural gas industry companies affairs in the Egyptian Ministry of Petroleum, GASCO's mission focuses on the management, operation, maintenance, upgrading, development & modernization of the National Gas Grid...' -- this supports EGAS (Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Co) as the ultimate holding-company owner of national-grid trunk pipelines that GASCO operates, which is the class-wide default attribution GEM uses for this pipeline. NOTE ON VERIFICATION: python scripts/url_verifier.py fails this URL with an SSLError (gasco.com.eg cert-chain issue, a known false-negative family per the verifier's own docstring); manually confirmed via curl -k (HTTP 200, valid PDF, 3.6MB) and by reading the extracted PDF text directly, which contains the EGAS/subsidiary language quoted above. Tier held at low: single source, and it documents general GASCO/EGAS corporate structure rather than title/ownership of this specific pipeline asset -- flagging for review rather than treating as confirmed project-level ownership.
